verdict.rationale: Linear's own GraphQL docs say the API is explorable and queryable through a public Apollo Studio instance with no download or login. Users can browse the schema in the Schema tab and run queries in the Explorer tab, and the docs provide concrete example queries and mutations. Introspection exposes the whole schema. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Explorer experience, evidence that the doc examples are pre-loaded as one-click runnable operations in the Explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
